nyheter.title: Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group Returns to San Diego After Nearly 11 Months
nyheter.summary: After 321 days, the Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group is home. Flagship USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) pulled into its berth at Naval Air Station North Island around 3:15 p.m. EST on Thursday. The record-breaking deployment, which saw the ship go 265 consecutive days at sea, is finally over.
